verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a banking platform that ships an API, SDKs and web banking, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or a usage-tracking opt-out in the API, the SDKs or the web interface. The IP allowlist and request signing are security controls, not privacy opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
